ledgerly.posting:
Ledgerly: Senior Product Designer, Payments
Amsterdam (hybrid, 3 days in office) · €75,000–€90,000 · Apply by 15 October

Ledgerly helps small businesses across Europe get paid on time. Our Payments team builds the flows that move money (invoicing, payouts, reconciliation), and we're looking for a senior designer to make them feel calm and trustworthy.

What you'll do
- Own the design of payment and payout flows end to end
- Work closely with engineering and compliance on high-stakes interactions
- Evolve our design system together with the platform team
- Plan and run research with small-business owners

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of product design, ideally on complex B2B tools
- You've built or maintained a design system
- You run user research independently
- Strong prototyping skills in Figma
- Accessibility know-how (WCAG 2.2)
- Experience with payments or fintech
- Dutch is a plus

letter.label: Opening paragraph
letter.text: I was excited to see the Senior Product Designer role on Ledgerly's payments team. Making complicated flows feel calm and trustworthy is what I've spent the last nine years on, and I'd love to do that for the small businesses you serve.

letter.label: Experience paragraph
letter.text: At Northwind Logistics I lead design for the carrier portal, which more than 4,000 dispatchers rely on every day. Much of that work comes down to what payments needs too: dense information, actions that are hard to undo, and people who can't afford mistakes. I also built and maintain our design system across six product teams, so consistency that scales is close to my heart.

letter.label: Fintech paragraph
letter.text: I haven't worked in payments directly yet, and I'd rather say so up front. What I bring instead is a habit of learning a domain through its users. At Fieldnote I ran monthly sessions with field researchers, and I'd start at Ledgerly the same way, with the business owners who depend on you.

letter.label: Closing paragraph
letter.text: I'm based in Rotterdam and happy to work hybrid from your Amsterdam office. I'd love to talk about how I could help. Thank you for your time.

chat.text: Here's what I tailored for Ledgerly:
list: Rewrote your summary around complex workflows and payments
Put design systems first at Northwind, and research first at Fieldnote
Ordered your skills by what Ledgerly asks for
Left out references, since the posting doesn't ask for them
Wrote a warm cover letter that's upfront about the fintech gap
